name: Perception
summary: Spot, hear, or otherwise detect presence.
description: Your Wisdom (Perception) check lets you spot, hear, or otherwise detect the presence of something. It measures your general awareness of your surroundings and the keenness of your senses.
typicalUses: Spot traps/hidden foes, listen at doors, notice ambushes.
exampleChecks: Hear whispering; notice a camouflaged hunter; spot a tripwire.
